lib/compact-redirects.ts.name: Redirect grouping
lib/compact-redirects.ts.description: Merges literal redirects with the same destination and status into one regex alternative, never across a pattern route, to cut Next's route count.

lib/http-headers.ts.name: Response headers
lib/http-headers.ts.description: Lists the header rules next.config.ts applies in order: the CSP directives, the service-doc Link header on /, and the tracked markdown paths.

lib/shared.ts.name: Site constants
lib/shared.ts.description: Holds the site name, titles, social handle, route prefixes, GitHub identity from vars.json, sidebar footer links and getSiteUrl.

lib/site-url.ts.name: Site URL rule
lib/site-url.ts.description: Resolves the absolute origin from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, throwing in a production build when it is missing or not a URL, else localhost.

next.config.ts.name: Next config
next.config.ts.description: Wires fumadocs-mdx, the compacted redirects with their .md twins, the /<slug>.md rewrites to the markdown mirror, and the site headers.

proxy.ts.name: Markdown fetch proxy
proxy.ts.description: Records markdown and llms*.txt fetches as PostHog llms_file_fetched events in production; the matcher admits only tracked paths.

redirects.config.ts.name: Redirect list
redirects.config.ts.description: Lists every redirect: move-doc entries between the AUTO-GENERATED markers, then hand-maintained legacy docs.arbitrum.io URLs with their permanence.

redirects.current.mjs.name: Stale Docusaurus redirect map
redirects.current.mjs.description: Maps old root-level docs.arbitrum.io URLs to /docs paths from a generator that no longer exists; nothing imports it.
